name: Coordination Chemistry
summary: Structure, bonding, spectra, magnetism and reactions of transition-metal complexes.

topics.name: Ligands, denticity, the chelate effect and coordination numbers
Geometries and isomerism of coordination complexes
Crystal field theory: d-orbital splitting, CFSE, high vs low spin
Ligand field and MO theory of complexes; the spectrochemical series
Electronic spectra: term symbols, Tanabe-Sugano diagrams and charge transfer
Magnetism of complexes: spin-only moments and orbital contributions
Thermodynamic stability: formation constants and the Irving-Williams series
Substitution mechanisms (associative, dissociative, interchange) and the trans effect
Electron-transfer reactions: inner- and outer-sphere mechanisms
Applications: pigments, MRI contrast agents and platinum anticancer drugs
